1.explanation: In Lighthouse v10+, performance audits rely on trace data gathered by the built-in `traces` gatherer. By defining a custom config with an explicit `artifacts` array that does _not_ include any trace‐related gatherers, you remove the source data that the metrics audits need. As soon as you call, for example, `first-contentful-paint`, it finds no trace to analyze, and throws its `Error('Required traces gatherer did not run.')`. The UI then shows every metric, opportunity, and diagnostic as an Error. This sample demonstrates exactly that misconfiguration so you can reproduce the red‐error layout in the report.
1.bug_scenario: When running Lighthouse against a page with a custom configuration that unintentionally omits the trace‐gathering artifacts, all of the performance metrics (First Contentful Paint, Speed Index, Time to Interactive, etc.), opportunities, and diagnostics will fail to render. In the report UI you’ll see “Error” badges and the message “Required traces gatherer did not run.” for every metric, opportunity, and diagnostic.
